convert_s3prl_checkpoint: convert an S3PRL checkpoint file to a HuggingFace UniSpeech-Sat model and save it to a dump path
convert_classification_weights: convert S3PRL downstream classification weights into a UniSpeechSatForSequenceClassification model
convert_diarization_weights: convert S3PRL downstream diarization weights into a UniSpeechSatForAudioFrameClassification model
convert_xvector_weights: convert S3PRL downstream x-vector weights into a UniSpeechSatForXVector model
run_cli_conversion: run the CLI script to convert an S3PRL checkpoint to HuggingFace format with base model name, config, and checkpoint paths
